# Optimus UI

> A community-maintained, MIT licensed suite of 80+ accessible Angular UI components.

Machine-readable API: https://optimus.openng.org/llms/manifest.json

## Guides

- [Installation](https://optimus.openng.org/installation): Setting up Optimus UI in an Angular CLI project.
- [Configuration](https://optimus.openng.org/configuration): Application wide configuration for Optimus UI.
- [Styled Mode](https://optimus.openng.org/theming/styled): Choose from a variety of pre-styled themes or develop your own.
- [Unstyled Mode](https://optimus.openng.org/theming/unstyled): Theming Optimus UI with alternative styling approaches.
- [Icons](https://optimus.openng.org/icons): OpenNG Icons is the default icon library of Optimus UI with over 250 open source icons.
- [Custom Icons](https://optimus.openng.org/customicons): Use custom icons with Optimus UI components.
- [Pass Through](https://optimus.openng.org/passthrough): Pass Through Props allow direct access to the underlying elements for complete customization.
- [Tailwind CSS](https://optimus.openng.org/tailwind): Integration between Optimus UI and Tailwind CSS.
- [LLMs.txt](https://optimus.openng.org/llms): LLM-optimized documentation endpoints for Optimus UI components.
- [Accessibility](https://optimus.openng.org/guides/accessibility): Optimus UI has WCAG 2.1 AA level compliance.
- [Animations](https://optimus.openng.org/guides/animations): Built-in CSS animations for Optimus UI components.
- [RTL](https://optimus.openng.org/guides/rtl): Right-to-left support for Optimus UI components.
- [PrimeFlex](https://optimus.openng.org/guides/primeflex): Moving from PrimeFlex to Tailwind CSS.
- [Philosophy](https://optimus.openng.org/philosophy): Why Optimus UI exists, what it commits to, and where it stops.
- [FAQ](https://optimus.openng.org/faq): Licensing, migration from PrimeNG, the ecosystem, and how support works.
- [Contribution Guide](https://optimus.openng.org/contribution): How to contribute to Optimus UI.

## Components

- [Accordion](https://optimus.openng.org/accordion): Accordion groups a collection of contents in tabs.
- [Animate On Scroll](https://optimus.openng.org/animateonscroll): AnimateOnScroll is used to apply animations to elements when entering or leaving the viewport during scrolling.
- [AutoComplete](https://optimus.openng.org/autocomplete): AutoComplete is an input component that provides real-time suggestions when being typed.
- [AutoFocus](https://optimus.openng.org/autofocus): AutoFocus manages focus on focusable element on load.
- [Avatar](https://optimus.openng.org/avatar): Avatar represents people using icons, labels and images.
- [Badge](https://optimus.openng.org/badge): Badge is a small status indicator for another element.
- [BlockUI](https://optimus.openng.org/blockui): BlockUI can either block other components or the whole page.
- [Breadcrumb](https://optimus.openng.org/breadcrumb): Breadcrumb provides contextual information about page hierarchy.
- [Button](https://optimus.openng.org/button): Button is an extension to standard button element with icons and theming.
- [Card](https://optimus.openng.org/card): Card is a flexible container component.
- [Carousel](https://optimus.openng.org/carousel): Carousel is a content slider featuring various customization options.
- [CascadeSelect](https://optimus.openng.org/cascadeselect): CascadeSelect displays a nested structure of options.
- [Chart](https://optimus.openng.org/chart): Chart components are based on Charts.js 3.3.2+, an open source HTML5 based charting library.
- [Checkbox](https://optimus.openng.org/checkbox): Checkbox is an extension to standard checkbox element with theming.
- [Chip](https://optimus.openng.org/chip): Chip represents entities using icons, labels and images.
- [ColorPicker](https://optimus.openng.org/colorpicker): ColorPicker is an input component to select a color.
- [ConfirmDialog](https://optimus.openng.org/confirmdialog): ConfirmDialog is backed by a service utilizing Observables to display confirmation windows easily that can be shared by multiple actions on the same component.
- [ConfirmPopup](https://optimus.openng.org/confirmpopup): ConfirmPopup displays a confirmation overlay displayed relatively to its target.
- [ContextMenu](https://optimus.openng.org/contextmenu): ContextMenu displays an overlay menu on right click of its target.
- [DataView](https://optimus.openng.org/dataview): DataView displays data in grid grid-cols-12 gap-4 or list layout with pagination and sorting features.
- [DatePicker](https://optimus.openng.org/datepicker): DatePicker is an input component to select a date.
- [Dialog](https://optimus.openng.org/dialog): Dialog is a container to display content in an overlay window.
- [Divider](https://optimus.openng.org/divider): Divider is used to separate contents.
- [Dock](https://optimus.openng.org/dock): Dock is a navigation component consisting of menuitems.
- [Drag and Drop](https://optimus.openng.org/dragdrop): pDraggable and pDroppable directives apply drag-drop behaviors to any element.
- [Drawer](https://optimus.openng.org/drawer): Drawer is a container component displayed as an overlay.
- [Dynamic Dialog](https://optimus.openng.org/dynamicdialog): Dialogs can be created dynamically with any component as the content using a DialogService.
- [Editor](https://optimus.openng.org/editor): Editor is rich text editor component based on Quill.
- [Fieldset](https://optimus.openng.org/fieldset): Fieldset is a grouping component with a content toggle feature.
- [FileUpload](https://optimus.openng.org/fileupload): FileUpload is an advanced uploader with dragdrop support, multi file uploads, auto uploading, progress tracking and validations.
- [Float Label](https://optimus.openng.org/floatlabel): FloatLabel appears on top of the input field when focused.
- [Fluid](https://optimus.openng.org/fluid): Fluid is a layout component to make descendant components span full width of their container.
- [Focus Trap](https://optimus.openng.org/focustrap): Focus Trap keeps focus within a certain DOM element while tabbing.
- [Gallery](https://optimus.openng.org/galleria): Galleria is an advanced content gallery component.
- [IconField](https://optimus.openng.org/iconfield): IconField wraps an input and an icon.
- [Ifta Label](https://optimus.openng.org/iftalabel): IftaLabel is used to create infield top aligned labels.
- [Image](https://optimus.openng.org/image): Displays an image with preview and tranformation options.
- [ImageCompare](https://optimus.openng.org/imagecompare): Compare two images side by side with a slider.
- [Inplace](https://optimus.openng.org/inplace): Inplace provides an easy to do editing and display at the same time where clicking the output displays the actual content.
- [InputGroup](https://optimus.openng.org/inputgroup): Text, icon, buttons and other content can be grouped next to an input.
- [InputMask](https://optimus.openng.org/inputmask): InputMask component is used to enter input in a certain format such as numeric, date, currency and phone.
- [InputNumber](https://optimus.openng.org/inputnumber): InputNumber is an input component to provide numerical input.
- [InputText](https://optimus.openng.org/inputtext): InputText is an extension to standard input element with theming and keyfiltering.
- [KeyFilter](https://optimus.openng.org/keyfilter): KeyFilter is a directive to restrict individual key strokes. In order to restrict the whole input, use InputNumber or InputMask instead.
- [Knob](https://optimus.openng.org/knob): Knob is a form component to define number inputs with a dial.
- [Listbox](https://optimus.openng.org/listbox): Listbox is used to select one or more values from a list of items.
- [MegaMenu](https://optimus.openng.org/megamenu): MegaMenu is navigation component that displays submenus together.
- [Menu](https://optimus.openng.org/menu): Menu is a navigation / command component that supports dynamic and static positioning.
- [Menubar](https://optimus.openng.org/menubar): Menubar is a horizontal menu component.
- [Message](https://optimus.openng.org/message): Message component is used to display inline messages.
- [MeterGroup](https://optimus.openng.org/metergroup): MeterGroup displays scalar measurements within a known range.
- [MultiSelect](https://optimus.openng.org/multiselect): MultiSelect is used to select multiple items from a collection.
- [OrderList](https://optimus.openng.org/orderlist): OrderList is used to sort a collection.
- [Organization Chart](https://optimus.openng.org/organizationchart): OrganizationChart visualizes hierarchical organization data.
- [Otp Input](https://optimus.openng.org/inputotp): Input Otp is used to enter one time passwords.
- [Overlay API](https://optimus.openng.org/overlay): This API allows overlay components to be controlled from the Optimus UI. In this way, all overlay components in the application can have the same behavior.
- [Paginator](https://optimus.openng.org/paginator): Paginator displays data in paged format and provides navigation between pages.
- [Panel](https://optimus.openng.org/panel): Panel is a container component with an optional content toggle feature.
- [PanelMenu](https://optimus.openng.org/panelmenu): PanelMenu is a hybrid of Accordion and Tree components.
- [Password](https://optimus.openng.org/password): Password displays strength indicator for password fields.
- [PickList](https://optimus.openng.org/picklist): PickList is used to reorder items between different lists.
- [Popover](https://optimus.openng.org/popover): Popover is a container component that can overlay other components on page.
- [ProgressBar](https://optimus.openng.org/progressbar): ProgressBar is a process status indicator.
- [ProgressSpinner](https://optimus.openng.org/progressspinner): ProgressSpinner is a process status indicator.
- [RadioButton](https://optimus.openng.org/radiobutton): RadioButton is an extension to standard radio button element with theming.
- [Rating](https://optimus.openng.org/rating): Rating component is a star based selection input.
- [Ripple](https://optimus.openng.org/ripple): Ripple directive adds ripple effect to the host element.
- [Scroll Panel](https://optimus.openng.org/scrollpanel): ScrollPanel is a cross browser, lightweight and skinnable alternative to native browser scrollbar.
- [Scroll Top](https://optimus.openng.org/scrolltop): ScrollTop gets displayed after a certain scroll position and used to navigates to the top of the page quickly.
- [Select](https://optimus.openng.org/select): Select is used to choose an item from a collection of options.
- [SelectButton](https://optimus.openng.org/selectbutton): SelectButton is used to choose single or multiple items from a list using buttons.
- [Skeleton](https://optimus.openng.org/skeleton): Skeleton is a placeholder to display instead of the actual content.
- [Slider](https://optimus.openng.org/slider): Slider is a component to provide input with a drag handle.
- [Speed Dial](https://optimus.openng.org/speeddial): SpeedDial is a floating button with a popup menu.
- [SplitButton](https://optimus.openng.org/splitbutton): SplitButton groups a set of commands in an overlay with a default action item.
- [Splitter](https://optimus.openng.org/splitter): Splitter is utilized to separate and resize panels.
- [Stepper](https://optimus.openng.org/stepper): The Stepper component displays a wizard-like workflow by guiding users through the multi-step progression.
- [StyleClass](https://optimus.openng.org/styleclass): StyleClass manages css classes declaratively to during enter/leave animations or just to toggle classes on an element.
- [Table](https://optimus.openng.org/table): Table displays data in tabular format.
- [Tabs](https://optimus.openng.org/tabs): Tabs is a container component to group content with tabs.
- [Tag](https://optimus.openng.org/tag): Tag component is used to categorize content.
- [Terminal](https://optimus.openng.org/terminal): 
- [Textarea](https://optimus.openng.org/textarea): Textarea adds styling and autoResize functionality to standard textarea element.
- [TieredMenu](https://optimus.openng.org/tieredmenu): TieredMenu displays submenus in nested overlays.
- [Timeline](https://optimus.openng.org/timeline): Timeline visualizes a series of chained events.
- [Toast](https://optimus.openng.org/toast): Toast is used to display messages in an overlay.
- [ToggleButton](https://optimus.openng.org/togglebutton): ToggleButton is used to select a boolean value using a button.
- [ToggleSwitch](https://optimus.openng.org/toggleswitch): ToggleSwitch is used to select a boolean value.
- [Toolbar](https://optimus.openng.org/toolbar): Toolbar is a grouping component for buttons and other content.
- [Tooltip](https://optimus.openng.org/tooltip): Tooltip directive provides advisory information for a component. Tooltip is integrated within various Optimus UI components.
- [Tree](https://optimus.openng.org/tree): Tree is used to display hierarchical data.
- [TreeSelect](https://optimus.openng.org/treeselect): TreeSelect is a form component to choose from hierarchical data.
- [TreeTable](https://optimus.openng.org/treetable): TreeTable is used to display hierarchical data in tabular format.
- [Virtual Scroller](https://optimus.openng.org/virtualscroller): VirtualScroller is a performance-approach to handle huge data efficiently.
